scope: Additive Noble Iron L1-18 Minion Prince opening-shot audit after the January 2026 range, shot-count and attack-speed balance.
game_version: Official March 2025 release, January 2026 balance and November 2025 TH18 HP adjustment; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Welcome to Clash Anytime Update!
facts: Noble Iron is Common Minion Prince Equipment unlocked at Blacksmith level 5.
It boosts speed, range and power of the Prince's first few projectiles; upgrading increases range, power and boosted projectile count.
sources.limitations: No per-level values, target eligibility, damage staging, attack-speed semantics or projectile timing are given.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
facts: All Noble Iron levels received increased range, number of shots and attack speed.
sources.limitations: The official note does not publish the new per-level values or resolve projectile behavior and cooldown rescheduling.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
facts: All Minion Prince Equipment gained 500 HP during the TH18 defensive rebalance.
sources.limitations: The statement does not establish attack-speed or opening-shot stat stacking.

sources.title: Noble Iron — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The dated table gives constant +500 Prince HP and L1-18 costs matching the pinned raw record.
It describes stronger, faster, longer-ranged opening attacks.
sources.limitations: The public table omits current damage, range, shot-count and attack-speed effect values.

sources.title: Pinned Noble Iron Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned payload gives L1-18 extra damage, range, boosted-shot count, attack-speed increase and +500 Prince HP.
The shot-count/range/speed series agrees with the public post-January community table.
sources.limitations: The commit lacks an explicit game-build date and cannot alone prove current effect continuity or attack timing.

sources.title: Noble Iron
facts: The page records a January 2026 all-level increase in shot count, range and attack speed; its current table matches the pinned series.
sources.limitations: The exact revision, table extraction method and game build are unpinned, so it is supporting context rather than authoritative current behavior.

observations.note: The pinned series resembles the post-January table, but the source lacks client-build version and projectile execution details.

derivations.result: Retain pinned opening-shot fields as catalogue data
derivations.method: Compare the raw record with official release and January qualitative buff; use the dated client table only to verify constant +500 Prince HP.

derivations.result: Record passive first-projectiles behavior without a Core modifier
derivations.method: The official release and raw ability type establish the passive trigger, but target, projectile, damage and cadence order remain missing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the pinned extra damage on the first N attack launch ticks
rejected_inferences.reason: The source does not define whether a missed, canceled or target-lost shot consumes a charge or whether count decrements on launch or impact.

rejected_inferences.rule: Replace the Prince's normal range with the pinned range before first target acquisition
rejected_inferences.reason: The official note says opening projectiles have greater range but does not define acquisition versus firing range phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Increase attack cadence by the pinned percentage via inverse integer cooldown
rejected_inferences.reason: Attack-speed bonus staging, rounding and interaction with other modifiers are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the unversioned community table as current client proof
rejected_inferences.reason: Its build and revision are unpinned despite matching the frozen candidate values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Noble Iron to defending Banner Prince
rejected_inferences.reason: The official wording describes opening projectiles but does not define defensive deployment or Banner lifecycle.

items: current post-January per-level extra damage, range, boosted count and speed continuity
charge consumption on launch, impact, miss, cancellation and retarget
range use in acquisition, travel, collision and target loss
attack-speed application to current cooldown and stacking with other Equipment/Pets
damage staging, mitigation, rounding and projectile tick order
defender Banner use and Prince HP stacking
Viewer projectile visuals and overlay, snapshot, replay and RL selection

conclusion: Noble Iron L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources confirm passive boosted opening projectiles and all-level January buffs; current numeric continuity and deterministic attack, projectile and charge ordering remain unresolved.
